explication: ONNX is an open model format and toolkit for representing, checking, annotating, and transforming AI computation graphs. A typical workflow creates or parses a model, checks its structure, infers missing types and shapes, then serializes or converts it for use by an inference runtime. The repository also defines operator schemas and provides a Python reference evaluator and graph utilities. The README documents the format and major utilities; only selected implementation excerpts were supplied, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
